第73章 各显神通，齐衡抵沪-《重生2000：撕了协议我暴富了》

三楼锦绣厅。

门关上之后。

包间里安静了足足十秒。

方副总裁端着的架子垮了。

他把筷子往桌上一拍，震得杯子晃了一下。

“周处长，你说的'好沟通'呢？”

周处长额角渗出汗，嘴张了两下。

“方总，这个……林川这人一直比较——”

“比较什么？比较狂？”

方副总裁扭头盯着他。

“我在北京二十年，省部级的谈判桌上坐过不下五十次。一个二十出头的毛孩子，当着我们的面起身就走？”

老吴在旁边缩着脖子，没敢插嘴。

孙乾倒没发火。

他摘下眼镜擦了擦。

“周处长，我问你一个问题。”

“您说。”

“张江现在的项目审批权，真的全在他手里？”

周处长咽了口唾沫。

“不是全在……但核心项目的入驻和退出，确实要经过九州创投的评审委员会。这是之前市经委批的流程。”

“市经委批的。”孙乾把眼镜架回去。

“批的是流程，不是终身制。”

方副总裁接过话。

“他做得再好，也只是一个民营创投公司的老总。张江是国家级高新产业园区，一个民企把着审批口子，上面能一直看着不动？”

周处长张了张嘴，没敢接。

方副总裁灌了口茶。

“行。明天分两路。”

他竖起一根手指。

“第一，我回北京，走部委那条内参通道。张江产业升级是全国试点，试点归试点，操盘方式可以调整。”

第二根手指竖起来。

“第二，孙总你留上海，直接去找经开委的人。不用绕陆局，找他上面。把联合运营体的框架先搭起来。”

孙乾端起茶杯喝了一口，杯底磕在桌面上。

“年轻人有本事，但不懂一个道理。”

他把杯子转了半圈。

“做生意讲规矩，那是江湖。到了一定的层面——规矩是上面定的。他定不了。”

第二天。

上午九点四十。

虹桥机场T2到达口。

两辆黑色奥迪A8并排停在贵宾通道外侧。

林川靠在第一辆车旁边，手插裤兜。

黑色高领羊绒衫，深灰休闲西裤，手工乐福鞋。

手腕上百达翡丽的陀飞轮在十月日光下转着。

叶知秋站在他身后两步远，手里抱着一个深蓝色文件袋——昨晚通宵整理的全套资料，厚度跟半本辞海差不多。

九点五十八分。

Splendid Hall on the third floor.

After the door closes.

The private room was quiet for ten seconds.

The air that Vice President Fang was holding collapsed.

He slapped his chopsticks on the table, causing the cup to shake.

"Director Zhou, where's the 'good communication' you mentioned?"

Director Zhou had sweat on his forehead and opened his mouth twice.

"Mr. Fang, this... Lin Chuan has always been more -"

"Compared to what? More crazy?"

Vice President Fang turned to stare at him.

"I have been in Beijing for twenty years and have sat at the provincial and ministerial level negotiation table no less than fifty times. A kid in his early twenties got up and left in front of us?"

Old Wu shrank his neck beside him and did not dare to interrupt.

Sun Qian didn't get angry.

He took off his glasses and wiped them.

"Director Zhou, let me ask you a question."

"You said."

"Is Zhangjiang's current project approval power really in his hands?"

Director Zhou swallowed.

"Not all... but the entry and exit of core projects must go through the review committee of Jiuzhou Venture Capital. This was the previous approval process of the Municipal Economic Commission."

"Approved by the Municipal Economic Commission." Sun Qian put his glasses back on.

"The approval is based on process, not tenure."

Vice President Fang took the call.

"No matter how good he is, he is still just the CEO of a private venture capital company. Zhangjiang is a national high-tech industrial park. If a private enterprise controls the approval process, how can the superiors keep watching?"

Director Zhou opened his mouth but did not dare to answer.

Vice President Fang took a sip of tea.

"Okay. We'll split into two ways tomorrow."

He held up a finger.

"First, I return to Beijing and take the internal reference channel of the ministries and commissions. Zhangjiang's industrial upgrading is a national pilot, and the pilot is a pilot, and the trading methods can be adjusted."

The second finger was raised.

"Second, Mr. Sun, you stay in Shanghai and go directly to the people from the Economic and Development Committee. No need to go around the Mainland Bureau, go to him. Set up the framework of the joint operation body first."

Sun Qian picked up the tea cup and took a sip. The bottom of the cup hit the table.

"Young people are capable, but they don't understand a principle."

He gave the cup a half turn.

"There are rules in doing business, that's the world. At a certain level - the rules are set by the higher-ups. He can't make them."

The next day.

Nine forty in the morning.

Hongqiao Airport T2 Arrival Gate.

Two black Audi A8s were parked side by side outside the VIP aisle.

Lin Chuan leaned against the first car, his hands in his trouser pockets.

Black turtleneck cashmere sweater, dark gray casual trousers, handmade loafers.

The Patek Philippe tourbillon on my wrist rotates in the October sun.

Ye Zhiqiu stood two steps behind him, holding a dark blue document bag in his hand - a complete set of information compiled all night long, about the same thickness as half a book of Cihai.

Nine fifty-eight.
